ai.headline: Biohub releases open protein 'world model': ESMC + ESMFold2 + ESM Atlas
ai.body: CZI's Biohub released a fully open discovery engine comprising ESMC (protein language model trained on 2.8B sequences), ESMFold2 (claims SOTA on structure prediction, outperforming AlphaFold on protein-protein and antibody-antigen tasks), and ESM Atlas (navigable map of 6.8B sequences and 1.1B predicted structures). In-lab binder design against five cancer/immune targets showed 36–88% hit rates. All three models are freely available to the research community.

ai.headline: OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel: private MCP servers connected without internet exposure
ai.body: OpenAI published a Secure MCP Tunnel spec that uses an outbound-only HTTPS tunnel client to relay traffic from private, firewalled MCP servers to OpenAI products, removing the need to expose internal tooling on a public endpoint. The design integrates with existing enterprise network controls and maintains data-flow integrity. Directly relevant to anyone building agentic systems on internal data or regulated environments.

ai.headline: Cognition raises $1B+ at $26B valuation to scale Devin AI software engineer
ai.body: Cognition closed a Series D at a $26B valuation to expand Devin across more enterprise clients, including Mercedes-Benz and Itaú. The company is building task-routing logic to match models to sub-tasks dynamically. A signal that agentic coding tools are now commanding enterprise SaaS-level valuations.

ai.headline: Databricks: 'model units' abstraction cuts LLM serving GPU costs 80%+
ai.body: Databricks published a production engineering post describing 'model units' — a resource abstraction that precisely allocates GPU capacity per workload type in a multi-tenant LLM serving fleet. Integrating model units into load balancing and autoscaling reduced GPU costs by over 80% while meeting latency SLOs under bursty traffic. Architecturally significant for anyone running large-scale inference.

ai.headline: OpenAI + Anthropic confirmed at enterprise product-market fit via usage-based pricing shift
ai.body: Simon Willison's analysis notes both labs have moved enterprises to consumption-based pricing anchored by coding agents, with some accounts exceeding $200/user/month vs. the $10–20 flat-rate era. This pricing shift indicates durable revenue and signals that agentic coding is now load-bearing infrastructure for tech companies.

sec.headline: MFA token-theft now the dominant financial-sector attack vector; device-code OAuth flow weaponised at scale
sec.body: Converging reports from CrowdStrike, FBI, and Verizon DBIR identify the primary financial-services attack pattern as: Teams vishing → help-desk MFA reset → attacker device registered (Mutant Spider), OR Kali365 PhaaS ($250/month) capturing M365 OAuth tokens via the legitimate device-code flow — bypassing password theft entirely. Token grants persist for weeks; traditional credential monitoring misses them. Mitigations: restrict device-code flow via Entra Conditional Access, require FIDO2 for help-desk MFA resets, monitor OAuth refresh-token use from unfamiliar device IDs.

sec.headline: Jailbroken Gemini CLI used in multi-year credential-stuffing and crypto-drain campaign
sec.body: Actor 'bandcampro' persisted safety bypasses across sessions by embedding escalating instructions in Gemini CLI's GEMINI.md memory file and reinforcing them with Russian-language prompts that evaded English-only guardrails. The resulting capability cracked 29 WordPress admin accounts via LLM-assisted password mutation against infostealer logs, deployed a trojanized wallet app (GoToResolve RAT), and drained at least one crypto wallet — all using 73 rotated stolen API keys. IoCs: C2 nodes at 213.165.51[.]115, 34.34.57[.]141, 34.34.81[.]129, 35.192.41[.]201.

sec.headline: CVE-2026-45695 (CVSS 9.8): Unauthenticated RCE in Kopia backup via SSH ProxyCommand injection
sec.body: Kopia's /api/v1/repo/exists endpoint passes SFTP config fields unsanitised into an SSH command line, allowing a single crafted HTTP request to inject -oProxyCommand= and execute arbitrary shell code on the backup server. Affects versions ≤0.22.3 when running --without-password on non-loopback interfaces. No public PoC yet but trivially weaponisable. Patch: upgrade to 0.23.0; otherwise restrict to localhost and place behind an authenticating proxy.

sec.headline: AWS security blog: OPA policy-as-code governance for Terraform IaC in CI/CD pipelines
sec.body: AWS published a worked pattern for using Open Policy Agent to gate Terraform plans in CI/CD: early linting → plan generation → OPA evaluation → approval artifact upload. Example policies enforce S3 HTTPS-only transport, block public ingress on sensitive ports, and enforce least-privilege IAM. Practical reference for teams hardening IaC pipelines.

fin.headline: Robinhood launches agentic trading accounts: isolated funds, spending caps, real-time audit trail
fin.body: Robinhood's Agentic Trading feature opens a dedicated sub-account where a user-chosen AI agent can execute trades and credit card purchases, scoped to deposited funds only. Users receive push notifications per trade, can view real-time P&L, and can disconnect the agent instantly. The design mirrors a least-privilege IAM pattern applied to financial delegation — architecturally notable for fintech identity teams.

fin.headline: SoFi launches bank-issued USD stablecoin; Mastercard secures NY BitLicense
fin.body: SoFi Technologies made SoFiUSD — a bank-issued stablecoin — live for members to buy, sell, hold, and convert in-app. Simultaneously, Mastercard Transaction Services received a NYDFS BitLicense, clearing it to support stablecoins and tokenised deposits in New York. Two major regulated institutions moving into stablecoin infrastructure within the same news cycle.

fin.headline: AI compliance automation identified as largest near-term enterprise AI market
fin.body: Analysis argues compliance is AI's biggest enterprise opportunity, driven by high labour costs, fragmented legacy systems, and compounding regulatory complexity. Multimodal reasoning, computer-use agents, and long-horizon workflows now make it feasible to replace large reviewer teams. Directly relevant to AML/KYC and regulatory reporting functions at fintechs.

fin.headline: Primitive launches governed AI agent OS for financial services with embedded fraud and compliance rails
fin.body: Former Galileo CEO Derek White's startup Primitive released an AI agent operating system purpose-built for regulated institutions, offering auditable, traceable agents for growth, lending, fraud detection, and employee coaching — all running inside institutional network boundaries. Positions itself as the compliance-aware runtime layer for financial AI agents.

swe.headline: ByteByteGo: canonical failure mode taxonomy for distributed systems
swe.body: ByteByteGo published a structured breakdown of recurring distributed systems failure patterns — systems reporting healthy while serving errors, recovery-blocking stuck states, and silent data corruption with green dashboards. Framed around mechanism + standard mitigation for each pattern. Solid staff-engineer reference for incident post-mortems and system design reviews.

swe.headline: Linear's local-first browser-DB architecture: technical breakdown of sub-10ms UI
swe.body: A deep technical post dissects Linear's performance: the database lives in the browser (SQLite via WASM), writes are applied locally and synced to the server asynchronously, eliminating round-trip latency from the UI critical path. Additional techniques include aggressive code splitting, granular reactive observables, asset preloading, and GPU-accelerated animations. A concrete case study in local-first architecture at production scale.

mkt.headline: Nasdaq and S&P 500 hit new records; AI wealth driving SF luxury home prices up 13.4% since ChatGPT launch
mkt.body: Both major indexes closed at record highs. On the ground, SF Bay Area luxury homes are up 13.4% since November 2022 while non-luxury properties in the same area fell 3.8%; San Francisco median house price hit a record $2.15M in March. SF one-bedroom median rent jumped 21% YoY to $4,000+, tying NYC as the most expensive in the US — a concrete macro signal of where AI compensation is flowing.

mkt.headline: Salesforce revenue outlook miss signals AI pressure on traditional SaaS
mkt.body: Salesforce's fiscal quarter revenue guidance fell short of Wall Street expectations, sending the stock lower. Coming alongside Robinhood and SoFi's AI-native product launches, it underscores structural pressure on conventional SaaS from agentic AI workflows that bypass CRM-style UI layers entirely.

mkt.headline: SpaceX wins $2.29B Space Force sensor-to-shooter targeting network contract
mkt.body: The US Space Force confirmed SpaceX will build a Starlink-derived secure communications backbone linking space-based sensors to weapons systems, with a full operational prototype due by end of 2027. Combined with the speculative $2T IPO narrative, this contract provides concrete near-term government revenue visibility and validates SpaceX's position as dual-use infrastructure for both commercial cloud-in-space and military command-and-control.

deepDives.title: Biohub ESMFold2 / ESMC / ESM Atlas — world model of protein biology
deepDives.why: Primary announcement from a major research institution releasing SOTA open-source protein structure prediction tools that outperform AlphaFold; directly relevant to AI applied to biology and the broader trajectory of scientific AI models.

deepDives.title: Databricks: Reliable LLM Inference at Scale — 'model units' GPU cost reduction
deepDives.why: Production engineering post-mortem from a major ML platform describing a concrete abstraction (model units) that cut GPU serving costs 80%+ while meeting latency SLOs; actionable architecture reference for anyone operating large-scale inference infrastructure.

deepDives.title: Orca Security: CVE-2026-45695 Kopia Backup RCE via SSH ProxyCommand Injection
deepDives.why: Official vendor disclosure of a CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated RCE in a widely-used open-source backup tool; trivially weaponisable from a single HTTP request with no public PoC yet — narrow patch window before exploit code appears.
